name: Jamaican Cornmeal Porridge
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical porridge recipes using ~1 cup cornmeal as base (serves 4); instructions imply 4 QT pot for multiple servings
Total time is sum of active prep (~5 min), boiling, 15-20 min cook, and final stirring; rounded to 30 min
Coconut milk classified as non-dairy but ambiguous for tree nuts (coconut allergy cross-classification varies); conservatively null
No explicit wheat, barley, rye, or oats; cornmeal is gluten-free
Sweetened condensed milk confirms dairy and milk allergen
No eggs, fish, shellfish, peanuts, soy, or sesame in listed ingredients
Vegetarian confirmed (includes dairy); vegan false due to condensed milk
instructions:
Add 2 ½ cups water, 1 can coconut milk to a 4 QT heavy bottomed pot. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, add 1 cup cornmeal and 1 ½ cup water to a large mixing cup and whisk until smooth.
Once the pot begins to boil, whisk in cornmeal mixture and continue to whisk for about 1 minute, ensuring there are no lumps. Reduce heat to low and cover with a tight fitting lid.
Cook over low heat for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. When there is about 5 minutes left, stir in vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and all-spice. Remove from heat and sweeten with condensed milk.
Serve and enjoy.
